title: Timeout and Retry Anti-Patterns in LLM-Generated Code: Benchmark and Analysis Code
description: A Go mock service that injects nine faults into HTTP exchanges (stalls at four points, transient 503s, 429 with Retry-After, a 30 s outage, refused connections, a reset after a write), the drivers that run Python, TypeScript, Java and Go solutions against it, and the scripts behind the tables of A Timeout Is Not a Deadline: An Empirical Study of Timeout and Retry Anti-Patterns in LLM-Generated Code. Preregistration: doi:10.5281/zenodo.24012023.
